sentences.en: Today in Long Valley, I found a Koel juvenile in a Black-collared Starling nest. There is another dead Koel juv hanging in the nest (the red circle).

sentences.en: A koel bird never makes her own nest. She lays her eggs in other nests.

sentences.en: A koel bird never makes her own nest. She lays her eggs in other nests and when they hatch, what do they do?
